title: Quality/Organizational Excellence Refresher
overview: Become a quality leader within your organization. The Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) certification equips professionals to make effective quality-related decisions at all organizational levels. This course serves as both a refresher and preparation for the CMQ/OE certification exam. It reinforces existing knowledge, reintroduces practical applications that may not be used daily, explains the rationale behind these tools, and highlights sample questions for both multiple-choice and constructed responses. Participants will also receive comprehensive course materials and a copy of the CMQ/OE Handbook: Fourth Edition.
audience: This course is aimed at individuals looking to strengthen their skills and knowledge to effectively understand and apply the CMQ/OE body of knowledge as preparation for the ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence exam.
methodology: This course is intended for individuals planning to take the CMQ/OE certification exam and is not an introductory course. However, the content is covered in enough detail to help those with basic understanding of the concepts strengthen their knowledge. Each topic is presented in a clear, practical manner, focusing on how to apply the covered tools. Participants will have opportunities to practice these tools during the course, along with optional homework exercises. A detailed manual, designed for exam reference, will be provided, offering a review of the exam topics and sample exams.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Review the body of knowledge (BOK) in preparation for the ASQ CMQ/OE exam.
Apply components of the BOK to better focus their preparation.
Explain the key concepts of each BOK element through discussions.
Refine their approach to the “constructed response” section of the exam.
Practice with sample tests to assess their readiness.
